facts.value: This stateless integer predicate returns true for 0xA0, 0xE1 and 0xEA–0xED. Direct and accumulated item-hit collision paths pass Item.kind; within those paths, after no fighter owner is identified, true selects the ftColl_8007861C preservation flag that leaves the victim's dmg.x18c4_source_ply unchanged rather than replacing it with 6. The death processor also uses the predicate on its recorded item-kind value to select victim decision 0x88 and opposing-source decision 0x80.
facts.rationale: Scopes the ownerless restriction to collision callers and includes the independently read death-processor consumers.

evidence.why: Fixed true set and victim-side consumer.

facts.value: Player/fighter resolution and final-hit metadata reads occur before the entity-index guard. Index 1 skips the subsequent bookkeeping and bonus-update block. Other indices copy final-hit metadata, update victim telemetry and evaluate indexed decisions. Sentinel-6, self or same-team attribution resets the victim's xD60 to 0 and xD64 to 6; opposing attribution may consume a matching source-player pending relationship, then sets the victim's xD60 to 0 and xD64 to the source slot. Source-player decisions are confined to the opposing-source branch and depend on motion, hit metadata, flags, thresholds and match queries.
facts.rationale: Corrects the overly absolute index-1 claim while preserving the observed guarded transitions.

evidence.why: Pre-guard reads, relationship predicate and guarded victim updates.
Exact attribution transitions and source-only decision block.

facts.value: Records eligible item acquisition or activation observations in the selected player's normalized item-category log. It increments x674 when that player's existing holder-history bit is clear and increments x710 when all six queried player-history bits are clear. It does not set history bits or independently guarantee once-per-instance counting.
facts.rationale: The complete body conditions its two increments on existing history queries. Attachment updates holder history elsewhere, so deduplication depends on caller sequencing and external state changes.

evidence.why: Shows normalization, eligibility, both history-conditioned increments, and absence of history writes.
Shows ordinary acquisition logging before attachment.
Shows a second observation context outside ordinary pickup notification.

facts.value: Reads gm_GetFrameCount() and sets player arg0's decision 0x5F to 1 when the count is at most pl_804D6470->xEC. Independently, when arg2 is nonzero and arg1 is not 6, it selects arg1's extended record and obtains the associated player from x0_staleMoveTable.xCB8. If unk_cond(arg1, associated_player) is false, xCBC.x3 in the inclusive range 0x33..0x3D sets that associated player's decision 0x2A to 1; independently, xCC0.x10_b0 sets decision 7 to 1 and decrements decision 6 only if its current value is nonzero.
facts.rationale: Refreshes the stale callee spelling while preserving the independently verified inputs, guards, recipients, and mutation semantics.

evidence.why: Shows the complete current function and canonical gm_GetFrameCount call.
Defines point replacement and zero-guarded decrement.

facts.value: Function signature: int pl_80040A9C(int player_slot). It sums nine u32 counter elements into an int accumulator and returns that int. The body does not enforce a nonnegative result or guard against out-of-range accumulation.
facts.rationale: Preserves the verified interface and counter types while removing an unsupported return-range guarantee.

evidence.why: Explicit signature, u32 pointer, int accumulator, and unguarded additions.
